benefit_text: The scheme helps set up new micro enterprises. Banks give a loan and the scheme pays subsidy. Maximum project cost is ₹50,00,000 for manufacturing and ₹20,00,000 for service. Special group pays 05% and the scheme pays 35% in rural areas.
who_can_apply: People above 18 years of age can apply. There is no income limit. Only new projects are allowed and one person from one family can apply.
documents: The application needs caste certificate and rural area certificate and project report and education certificate.
how_to_apply: People go to the official PMEGP portal and choose application for new unit. People fill the form and upload the papers and submit.
